1.translation: This page explains the composition of one complete reference map. pETDuet-1 and its dense-label choices are described [separately](⟦shared:0⟧).

7.translation: The double backbone carries source positions. All reference features retain their original intervals, strands and segments. Feature labels share the stacking Position; independent primers and restriction sites use their own tables and layers. The centre gives identity and complete length.

10.translation: The chosen source profile contains 9 features and 39 restriction rows at 33 distinct positions. It has no independent reference-primer rows. Raw enzyme matches remain in ⟦shared:0⟧; the declared source profile is not a three-site display subset.

12.translation: Prepared annotation, primer and site tables can go directly to independent layers. Sequence recognition is optional when the tables already exist. Full lengths and source units must be supplied independently.
